audience_aware_paths.principle: Content is re-ranked or re-labelled per persona — same atoms, different emphasis.

rep_card_geo_aware.geo_source: IP-based approximation with optional zip override

editorial_hero_block.treatment: dark stripe · 260–420px · full-bleed in-situ photography · 40/60 gradient for text legibility
editorial_hero_block.where_it_appears: every top-level hub page + series/collection/space detail

cta_dual_path.pattern: Always offer two — one self-service, one human (rep). Buyers split on whether they want to talk to someone.
cta_dual_path.example: Home footer band: 'Get a Quote' + 'Find Your Rep'

dealer_gating.rule: Tiered pricing and dealer price lists gated behind /login. Public site shows retail/MSRP or 'request pricing' depending on context. Never show wholesale pricing to an un-auth'd visitor.

design_intent_hints.sidebar_mood: dark · monospace · wireframe feel evokes in-progress craft — the FINAL site should feel material-first, not wireframe-y. Use the wireframe as IA/layout only, not as visual direction.

brand_accent_colors.accent_green: #95ff00 (wireframe annotation color — TBD whether it survives to final)

design_intent_hints.typography_intent: large, confident, typographically-led. Display type carries the brand. No placeholder lorem.
design_intent_hints.photography_intent: in-situ > product-on-white. Real rooms, real hands, real light. Craft visible.
design_intent_hints.interaction_feel: calm and direct. The site is for pros making real decisions — no marketing theatrics, no modal assault.
